process-proof-points.label: Handled

process-proof-points.text: The film shows the physical movement behind the product: lifting, rinsing, sorting, cutting, finishing, and packing.

process-proof-points.label: Checked
process-proof-points.title: Natural material, judged piece by piece
process-proof-points.text: Colour, clarity, size, grain, and fractures all affect what each piece can become.

process-proof-points.label: Finished
process-proof-points.title: Machine cut, human refined
process-proof-points.text: The work keeps the irregular mineral character while making each item ready for use or display.

process-proof-points.label: Arrived
process-proof-points.title: From workshop to home
process-proof-points.text: The close is not another step list: it brings the journey home as a finished object with warmth and presence.

process-steps.label: Mine
process-steps.title: Mined rock salt
process-steps.text: Raw rock salt is extracted from mines and loaded onto trucks for the first leg of the journey.

process-steps.label: Sort

process-steps.text: The material reaches the Karachi warehouse, where it is washed, dried, and separated by colour and quality.

process-steps.label: Cut
process-steps.title: Cut and shaped
process-steps.text: Rock salt is cut into natural lamps, specific shapes, bowls, bricks, tiles, and other product forms.

process-steps.label: Finish
process-steps.title: Hand finished
process-steps.text: Each cut piece is carefully hand-crafted by skilled workmen so the natural material keeps its character.

process-steps.label: Pack
